title: peucedanum oligophyllum
intro: Peucedanum oligophyllum, commonly known as Chinese angelica or Shan zha, is a plant species in the carrot family. It is used in traditional Chinese medicine for its potential health benefits, including reducing inflammation and improving cardiovascular health. The therapeutic actions of Peucedanum oligophyllum include its antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and anti-angiogenic properties, which may help to prevent the formation of new blood vessels that feed tumors. The bioactive constituents of this plant include phenolic acids, flavonoids, and lignans, which contribute to its therapeutic effects.
